/*insertBuyerStockList*/
INSERT INTO BUYER_STOCK_LIST( BUYER , WAREHOUSE_CODE , JOB_TYPE , JOB_NO , ITEM_NO , ITEM_QTY , JOB_DATE , JOB_TIME , JOB_NOTE , CREATE_USER_ID , CREATE_DEPT_CD , JOB_USER_ID , JOB_DEPT_CD , GR_NO , GR_SEQ , STATUS ) VALUES ( #{BUYER} , 'W' , 'CHUL' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')||TO_CHAR(F_BUYER_SQMT(#{BUYER},'CHUL'),'FM0000') , #{BUYER_ITEM_NO} , TO_NUMBER(#{RS_QTY}) * DECODE(#{STATUS_FLAG},'D',1,-1) , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , NULL , #{USER_ID} , (SELECT MAX(DEPARTMENT) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID}) , #{USER_ID} , (SELECT MAX(DEPARTMENT) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID}) , #{GI_NO} , TO_CHAR(#{GI_SEQ}, 'FM000000') , DECODE(#{STATUS_FLAG},'D','D','C') )

/*insertBuyerStock*/
MERGE INTO BUYER_STOCK USING DUAL ON (BUYER = #{BUYER} AND WAREHOUSE_CODE = 'W' AND ITEM_NO = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TOT_QTY = TOT_QTY + #{RS_QTY} * DECODE(#{STATUS_FLAG},'D',1,-1) , AVAIL_QTY= AVAIL_QTY + #{RS_QTY} * DECODE(#{STATUS_FLAG},'D',1,-1) , CHANGE_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUYER , WAREHOUSE_CODE , ITEM_NO , STATUS , TOT_QTY , ALLOC_QTY , AVAIL_QTY , PRE_GR_QTY , CREATE_DATE , CHANGE_DATE) VALUES (#{BUYER} ,'W' ,#{BUYER_ITEM_NO} ,'C' ,TO_NUMBER(#{RS_QTY}) * DECODE(#{STATUS_FLAG},'D',1,-1) ,0 ,TO_NUMBER(#{RS_QTY}) * DECODE(#{STATUS_FLAG},'D',1,-1) ,0 ,SYSDATE ,SYSDATE)

UPDATE BUYER_STOCK_RSDT SET COMPLETE_MARK = 'N' WHERE (BUYER, RS_NO, RS_SEQ, RS_REVISION) IN ( SELECT BUYER, RS_NO, RS_SEQ, RS_REVISION FROM BUYER_STOCK_GIDT WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND GI_NO = #{GI_NO} AND GI_SEQ = #{GI_SEQ} ) AND COMPLETE_MARK = 'Y' AND STATUS != 'D'
